title: Consolidate search to one endpoint
goal: Collapse the 4+ search implementations into one canonical search endpoint/contract with FTS backend and rate limiting

in: direct /api/search clients requiring the canonical response shape

acceptance_criteria: Canonical search endpoint adopted by core launch clients and incompatible legacy paths are retired or explicitly compatibility-gated
Server-side distributed rate limiting is verified against configured Redis
Search results enforce authorization and tenant visibility before returning records
Supabase-backed deployed staging search, authorization-negative, and 429 behavior pass
